doc.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: A typical week on staff at ABC
summary: Hired about 1957, he works up to three shows a week from a posted schedule.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: So what would a typical week – when you – you were hired full time in ’57 for ABC? Was that when you . . . ?
What would a typical work week be like for you as a player? Would you be on one show?

It depended on – no, you might do as many as three in the week. You might do a radio show or two radio shows, and you might have a television show to do. Or sometimes you just did one thing. You might just be assigned to one thing. You get your schedule. It would be posted. You’d go in and look at it before you left at the end of the week. It would tell you what you had to do the following week. It was very well organized. All networks worked the same way.
